liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Peggy-O** (2 reviews): Singled out as a sweet first-set highlight, alongside a fun Iko Iko and Looks Like Rain into Deal; Jerry's voice and guitar playing on it sound especially nice to this listener [16][17]
- **Mama Tried** (2 reviews): Mama Tried into Mexicali Blues is called fantastic, a cowboy duet that cooks despite usually not being a highlight; Mama Tried into Mexicali Blues called out of control, a highlight alongside Peggy-O, Tennessee Jed and Stella Blue [18][25]
- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Described as sublime though not very long; Bird Song and Sugaree are named as highlights, with Deal also liked [16][23]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Seriously fun, with Jerry very strong vocally [22]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer thinks Sugaree is so good it deserves more attention than it has received [22]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Listener says Jerry's guitar sound on Estimated Prophet is unforgettable [19]
- Reviewer finds the encore tedious [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-04-12.sbd.miller.32014.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 164 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1982-04-12.sbd.miller.95638.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 163 min; rated 3.8/5 by 10 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard is crisp with a great drum sound and Phil well up in the mix; Soundboard, a Charlie Miller transfer, is described as crisp and excellent; Reviewer says the audience recording does the show more justice than the soundboard [20][22][24][25]
- **gd1982-04-12.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-32014.35160.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 163 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [4]
- **gd1982-04-12.138011.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 168 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [2]

## Around the show

- Attendee's first show at age 14, floor seat in row 16 for twenty dollars [19]
- Recalls this being about when Jerry changed his position on the stage [19]
- Reviewer says this show is far better than the previous night's 4-11 show, which was sloppier despite good energy [16]
- Calls it part of a strong spring 1982 tour, with incredible shows in Philly, New York, Baltimore and Hartford [20]
- Playing is competent but less tight than many shows from earlier and later years; Bob slurs words [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-04-12.sbd.miller.32014.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Soundboard source uses an audience cassette master from LMA to patch two seconds of Sugaree, and all of Sugar Magnolia and Satisfaction; The audience patch was speed corrected by Jay Ashley [1]
- **gd1982-04-12.sbd.miller.95638.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k) [3]. Also: Remastered, pitch-corrected version of shnid 32014, with help from Joe B. Jones on the pitch correction [3]
- **gd1982-04-12.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-32014.35160.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Bill Tetzeli; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k) [4]. Also: Audience patches from shnid 9508 were pitch corrected to match the soundboard and redone in CE Pro; The Satisfaction encore was pitch corrected against an electronic keyboard on the uploader's laptop [4]
- **gd1982-04-12.138011.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne;Soundboard (shnid:95638), Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k),Transfer Info:Dat (Sony D8) -> VX Pocket 440… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Gregg Nixon Grateful Dead: [1982-04-11 Nassau Coliseum, Uniondale, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1982-04-11-nassau-coliseum-uniondale-ny-usa/) [33]
